newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close slightly up in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close slightly up in mixed trade.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed marginally higher as both sellers and buyers were active on Wednesday, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 7.45 points or 0.61 percent up at 1,225.49 on a turnover of 57.6 million taka. Of 125 traded issues 50 gained, 70 lost and five were unchanged.
National Tubes gained 48 taka to 1,218, Food scrips Pran lost 11 to 705 and Monno Fabrics was up 1.36 to 151.43.
